decisive_spans.text: Contrast-enhanced abdominal CT: revealed an enhanced left-adrenal heterogeneous mass

response.rationale: The presence of an adrenal mass, tachycardia, and elevated cardiac biomarkers strongly supports Pheochromocytoma. While Catecholamine-induced cardiomyopathy is a related condition, Pheochromocytoma is the underlying cause of the catecholamine excess. Stress cardiomyopathy and Takotsubo cardiomyopathy are less specific diagnoses given the adrenal mass.
